archetypes.name: dyn-gate-render
archetypes.rationale: Gate prompt copy moved from markdown to a KV renderer with cap-sensitive branching.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new design_gate_render renderer and its callers in approval-gates.md. Check that Gate A, Gate B default, and Gate C outputs preserve the visible chooser semantics, including no CR/LF in KV values, non-numeric review-round warnings, panel-failed approval relabeling, and cap-aware option removal. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
